title: Beginner security study pathway and flexible summer start
status: Reviewed learning plan. No learner completion is implied.

entry_skills.files: Find a folder, read a text file, save a new copy and tell an original from an attempt.
entry_skills.permission: Explain that ownership and permission have a stated scope and end point.
entry_skills.vm-introduction: Explain host, guest and a disposable practice computer; no setup is implied.
entry_skills.addresses-ports: Recognise an IP address and port; say which end sends and which receives.
entry_skills.client-server: Explain a client request and a server reply.
entry_skills.names: Recognise a domain name and distinguish a name from an address.
entry_skills.time: Read a time offset and UTC; keep the source time alongside a converted time.
entry_skills.http: Explain request, response and HTTPS at a basic level.
entry_skills.processes: Explain a running program, its parent and why a name alone does not identify intent.
entry_skills.identity-access: Distinguish checking identity from deciding permitted actions.
entry_skills.data-boundaries: Explain public, private and dummy practice data.
entry_skills.versions: Compare simple software version numbers without assuming a higher-looking number is safe.
entry_skills.python-basics: Read variables, a loop and a file in a small Python example before writing a helper.
entry_skills.snort-rule: Read protocol, direction, content and identifier in a simple Snort rule.
entry_skills.evidence-statements: Separate an observed fact, a possible explanation and a missing check.

entry_and_diagnostic_sessions.E1: Check folders, copies, permission and available local tools; keep originals.
entry_and_diagnostic_sessions.E2: Check the few terms needed next; note missing knowledge or setup without installing anything.
entry_and_diagnostic_sessions.D1: Choose existing university or practice evidence for up to two familiar topics; explain evidence, limits and help used to a reviewer.
entry_and_diagnostic_sessions.D2: Attempt one short unfamiliar local case before seeing its answer; reviewer selects guided entry or direct U route.

session_contract.split_rule: Long README tasks span multiple numbered continuation slots, for example P10.G.2. Finish at a safe stopping point; add time rather than compress the work.
session_contract.solo_rule: No worked answer or previous solution. Command syntax and model rules may be consulted and logged. A hinted attempt remains prompted.
session_contract.unseen_rule: Reviewer prepares changed reasoning within the supported model and retains a separate answer key; merely renaming a known case or repeating a seed is rehearsal. No automated check before the first answer is preserved.
session_contract.teach_back_rule: In U, explain the question, chosen check, exact evidence, a limit, an alternative and next action. For a fix include normal use and the case to block.
session_contract.prerequisite_gate: Before starting a dependent package, obtain review of the required skill through U or equivalent retained evidence. Actual tool prerequisites cannot be satisfied by supplied transcripts alone.
session_contract.assessment_bypass: Existing evidence plus a successful reviewer-selected unseen attempt can replace G and S. Keep U, R7 and R28 and record the decision. A self-rating or course enrolment cannot do this.
session_contract.review_unavailable: Keep the attempt marked awaiting review. Do not claim independent completion or unlock the final capstone; choose an unrelated ready topic or practise with prompts.
session_contract.recall_policy: Use actual U date plus 7 and 28 days. If delayed, record actual date and restart due dates after a retry; a missed date is not a failed person.
stop_conditions: Unknown command effect or unavailable tool
Required environment is not already prepared
session_contract.retry_rule: Preserve the first answer; identify one gap; use a guided example for that gap; retry different facts on another day. New help changes the recorded stage, not the history.
session_contract.primary_slot_semantics: primary_slot numbers G/S/U in the full learning route; it is not a dated timetable. The sample summer schedules separately place those passes on actual relative days.

summer_options.flex_rule: F means review, continuation, catch-up or rest. Use it for a later branch only if prerequisites and tool gates are satisfied; never fill every spare slot by default.
summer_options.day_rule: Keep G, S and U on different days. Eight slots may mean two slots on some days with a break; no same-day rush through one package.
summer_options.unknown_availability: These are two examples. Care and study needs take priority. Reduce slots or stretch week numbers without creating a catch-up debt.
summer_options.schedule_semantics: Daily schedules are illustrative and chronological. day_slot orders two sessions on one day with a break. schedule flattens that daily order per week; package summer_weeks.slot is its display index. Day 1 may be any chosen starting weekday. Move dependent tasks and recalls when U slips.

capacity.qualification: Planning arithmetic, not a prediction of mastery. Reviewed prior evidence may remove G/S; unfamiliar tasks, real tool setup, breaks and repeats add time.

safe_transfer_tasks.name: Local evidence CTF
safe_transfer_tasks.task: Reviewer hides three answer tokens in fresh fictional evidence questions. Earn each by submitting exact evidence and a limit; a guessed flag alone is insufficient.

safe_transfer_tasks.name: Local repair CTF
safe_transfer_tasks.task: Use only the supplied local application. Retest a blocked cross-user request and a valid owner request, then write a short finding.

safe_transfer_tasks.name: Small team handover challenge
safe_transfer_tasks.task: Use a fresh synthetic packet. One person investigates, another checks the evidence, and another drafts a short update. Swap roles on a different case.

external_events: No external service is recommended. Before any future event, check the current official rules, exact targets, permitted methods, data handling and stop time. Joining or testing needs separate scope; this draft performs none.

validation.limits: Checks cover coverage, declared dependency order, session identity and schedule arithmetic. They do not verify learner skill, new case correctness, real tool operation, publication or availability.
